svg.title: Chapter 3, where friction begins: before value is proven, the product asks for commitment. The funnel today: install app, create account, trial and upsell, watch lesson, experience Eureka. Trial pressure and enrollment asks appear within minutes, before meaningful learning, shown by an in app banner reading Trial ends in 06d 21h 35m with an Enroll Now button. The strongest part of the product appears after onboarding, so urgency appears before trust. Second friction: language. Chapters are English first. Students who learn best in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil or Marathi hit a comprehension wall before they reach the value; the language barrier appears before product understanding, students lose confidence early and confusion replaces curiosity.

section.h2: Where friction begins: urgency before trust.
section.p: Before value is proven, the product asks for commitment.

div.p: Recreated from the in app banner shown in the teardown.
Trial pressure and enrollment prompts surface within minutes, before meaningful learning happens. The strongest part of the product appears after onboarding, so commitment feels premature.
Chapters are English first. Students who learn best in another language hit a comprehension wall before they reach the value. Confusion replaces curiosity, and they lose confidence early.
